issue.title: tick CLI tests pin 2026-11-18 but the readiness gate reads the host's real day, so 12 tick:: tests fail on master from 2026-11-19
issue.description:
## What fails

Twelve `tests/cli/tick.rs` integration tests fail on both `test (ubuntu-latest)` and
`test (macos-latest)` in every master CI run whose tests executed on or after
2026-11-19 UTC:

- run 44425211434 (3617c2ea, the bob tick landing) — ubuntu job 135228338263 and macOS job 135228338050
- run 44458078724 (e6395f2e)
- run 44493916247 (e07a26bf) — ubuntu job 135456164648, macOS job 135456164557

Each run reports `3811-3815 passed; 12 failed` in `-p bob-obsidian --test cli`, and the
12 failures are exactly the `tick::` nodes:
abrupt_death_keeps_follow_up_intent, failure_restarts_clock_and_keeps_last_success,
five_minute_ticks_preserve_cadence_and_floor_jitter,
gcal_yesterday_scope_cooldown_and_waiting_status, human_views_match_colorless_snapshots,
intake_pulls_derive_even_when_their_intervals_are_longer,
named_all_off_and_follow_up_are_explicit, per_step_summaries_come_from_real_json_shapes,
readiness_missing_then_ready_and_unrendered,
spawn_failure_has_no_interval_and_quiet_shows_only_errors,
termination_forwards_to_group_and_persists_interruption,
timeout_kills_group_and_continues_later_steps.

Typical assertion (tests/cli/tick.rs:165):
`left: ["gmail", "refs", "projects"]  right: ["gcal", "gmail", "refs", "projects", "tasks"]`
— gcal and tasks are skipped because the readiness gate is closed.

## Root cause

`src/native/tick/gates.rs::readiness_gate(vault, now)` takes the scheduler clock `now`
(BOB_TICK_NOW in tests) but reads `pomodoro::day_file_for(vault)`, which resolves the
daily note from the host's real wall clock. The test fixture (`Fixture::new` in
tests/cli/tick.rs) writes only `vault/2026/20261118.md` and pins BOB_TICK_NOW to
2026-11-18, and its own comment says it assumes "the host runs the same day". From
2026-11-19 on, the real-day note is missing, the gate returns `waiting/note_missing`, and
the gcal/tasks steps never run.

The gate already computes `today` from `now` and the gcal path
(`gcal::snapshot::daily_relative_path(today)`); it only uses that for a mismatch warning.

## Suggested fix

Resolve readiness's day file from the `now`-derived `today` (the gcal path it already
computes), so the scheduler clock is the single date authority, and keep (or drop) the
mismatch warning against `pomodoro::day_file_for` as appropriate. Then the hermetic
fixture works on any host date. Alternatively/additionally make the fixture write the
note for the date it pins rather than relying on the host date. Verify with
`cargo test -p bob-obsidian --test cli tick::` under a faked host date (or on any day
other than 2026-11-18) and `just check`.

Discovered by bob-cli-n7.land while verifying that master CI still passes the n7 epic's
macOS nodes; the n7 nodes all pass in these runs and this failure is unrelated to n7.
Introduced by the closed bob tick epic bob-cli-nb.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: All 12 tick:: nodes fail identically on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest in three consecutive master runs (44425211434, 44458078724, 44493916247) and the cause is deterministic: the readiness gate resolves today's note from the host clock while the fixture only writes 20261118.md, so every run after 2026-11-18 fails.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-n7.land found master CI red on both platforms solely from these tick tests while verifying the n7 macOS nodes; no existing bead tracks it and it blocks the release train.
